description: Dataset of Google Maps places within a set radius of a coordinate, each with name, rating, address, distance from center, and coordinates.

places.description: Dataset of places found near the input coordinates. Each record includes name, categoryName, totalScore, reviewsCount, address, phone, website, priceLevel, placeId, plusCode, location (lat/lng), distanceFromCenter (human-readable), distanceFromCenterMeters (numeric), googleMapsUrl, and scrapedAt.
places.title: Nearby Places

title: Google Maps Radius Search Around a Coordinate Output
